answer: Someone running 175 aliases thus needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in dawn, expire in bridge, and ember lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2588 identities would post 2894 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
